title: Tuning In
description: Alright, welcome to 🎵 TuneTailor. This isn't just a music player; it's where your local music meets AI, all detailed in the `README.md`.
panel_text: Alright, newbie, welcome to 🎵 TuneTailor! Ditch those old playlists; we've got AI here.
speech_bubble: Alright, newbie, welcome to 🎵 TuneTailor! Ditch those old playlists; we've got AI here.

title: The Request Reel
description: Users interact with the Dynamic Dashboard. Their requests flow from `public/index.html` through `public/app.js`, kicking off the intent process.
panel_text: Your natural language queries hit the Dynamic Dashboard, driving `public/app.js` to get things rolling.
speech_bubble: Your natural language queries hit the Dynamic Dashboard, driving `public/app.js` to get things rolling.

title: The Maestro's Mind
description: Here's where the magic happens: the Gemini LLM deciphers intent, mapping natural language queries to specific actions, potentially using `alexa_skill/interactionModel.json` for context.
panel_text: The Gemini LLM then maps your query, probably referencing something like `alexa_skill/interactionModel.json`.
speech_bubble: The Gemini LLM then maps your query, probably referencing something like `alexa_skill/interactionModel.json`.

title: Your Turn to Play
description: The payoff? Your contributions will help manage and play local music. Get ready to tweak the `src` logic or expand the `songs` library.
panel_text: Now you can actually contribute to managing and playing `songs`. Go make your mark in `src`!
speech_bubble: Now you can actually contribute to managing and playing `songs`. Go make your mark in `src`!
